Why we exist

Wellness shouldn't wait until adulthood.

We believe the habits that shape a healthy life: movement, mindfulness, nutrition, and community. These are best built early, by teens, for teens.

💪

Move with purpose

Peer-led fitness sessions and challenges that make movement social, fun, and sustainable, not intimidating.

🧠

Mind matters too

Workshops on stress, sleep, and mental health, built around real teen experiences and led by trained student facilitators.

🌱

Grow a chapter

A turnkey playbook lets any student launch a chapter at their school in weeks, with national support behind them.

One organization. A growing network of student leaders.

Our Mission

Empowering teens to take ownership of their own wellness, and each other's.

Placeholder mission copy: Teen Wellness Society exists to close the gap between what teens know about health and what they actually practice, by putting students in charge of the solution.

Our Story

Teen Wellness Society was created by a teen after the problems they witnessed when they navigated high school and saw many students' health choices because of misinformation on the Internet and convenience.

Building habits and a balanced life was a difficult challenge for them and their classmates because it required consistency where motivation wasn't always there, the courage to be different when everyone else did the same thing, and independence where it felt lonely.

Teen Wellness Society was founded to combat those problems and make sure there was a community supporting the right kind of effort.

The problem

Teens are stressed, sedentary, and stretched thin.

Rising anxiety, shrinking sleep, and disappearing PE time have left a generation that knows wellness matters but lacks the structure, role models, and community to act on it. [Placeholder: replace with your real research / stats.]

Our approach

Peer-led, not adult-prescribed.

Every workshop, challenge, and chapter is built and run by teens. We provide the playbook, training, and national network. Students provide the energy and credibility that actually moves the needle.

Founding a chapter

How to start a chapter, step by step

1

Apply online

Fill out a short founder application telling us about your school and why you want to lead.

Open the Chapter Application →
2

Get matched with a mentor

Every new founder is paired with a current chapter leader who guides you through your first semester.

3

Recruit your founding team

Use our recruitment kit (flyers, sign-up forms, sample pitch) to build a team of 3–5 fellow students.

4

Get school approval

We provide a template proposal and constitution to help you register as an official student club.

5

Host your launch event

Kick off with a welcome workshop using our starter toolkit, and join the national chapter network.

Volunteer Opportunities

How volunteer hours are earned

Every contribution counts toward your recognition tier. Here's how hours are logged for content and event work.

📱

Positivity post

A short, uplifting Instagram post: a quote, a reminder, or a quick win. 1 hour each.

📚

Educational post

A post that teaches something: a wellness tip, a habit, or a fact. 2 hours each.

🔬

Research-based educational post

An educational post backed by cited research or studies. 3 hours each.

🎬

Short-form animated video

An animated video for Instagram Reels or TikTok. 4 hours each.

🎤

Host a pop-up workshop

Plan and run a full wellness workshop for your school or community. 10 hours each.

🙌

Volunteer at a TWS event

Show up and help run a Teen Wellness Society event, setup, check-in, logistics, support. 5 hours each.

Origin story

It started with one workshop in a gym.

Teen Wellness Society was built by a teen who saw firsthand how hard it was to make healthy choices in high school. Misinformation online and the pull of convenience made it easy to fall into habits that didn't serve anyone. Building a balanced life took consistency even when motivation ran out, the courage to be different when everyone around her chose the easier path, and independence that often felt isolating. She watched her friends struggle with the same pressures and knew something had to change.

"Wellness can be fun!" TWS Founder

Questions

FAQ

How do I log my volunteer hours?+

Once you register as a volunteer, a volunteer tracker will be provided to you where you can log and submit your hours.

Can I get recognized without starting a chapter?+

Yes, volunteers and workshop hosts earn the same tiered recognition as chapter leaders.

Do recognition tiers reset each year?+

Your total hours never reset. They're cumulative for life. However, your recognition tier resets annually on your volunteer anniversary, so you can keep earning new tiers each year. For example, you might earn Bronze in your first year and Gold in your second.
